title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
slides: What does OpenAI want with a travel startup?
It acquired Odessia, founded by Sonder's creator
The founder already built one travel giant
Travel bookings may soon run on AI agents
Watch for AI-planned trips replacing search engines
thread_text:
1. OpenAI's Travel Ambition

OpenAI just acquired Odessia, a travel startup founded by the creator of Sonder. This isn't a side project — it's a signal that AI agents are coming for your next vacation.

2. The Founder's Track Record

Lucas Vandenberghe built Sonder into a $1B hospitality giant. Now he's building AI that could bypass traditional travel agencies entirely.

3. AI Agents Book for You

Odessia's platform lets AI agents handle bookings, compare options, and execute purchases. No more browsing 20 tabs — just tell your assistant where you want to go.

4. Search Engines Under Threat

If AI agents plan and book trips, Google's $200B travel ad business takes a hit. Travelers won't need to search — they'll just ask.

5. Try This Today

Open ChatGPT and ask it to plan a full weekend trip with budget and bookings. If the result feels clunky, imagine it in two years. Would you still open a browser?
